title: Advanced
description: Configuration file, workarounds, work safety and diagnostics.

sections.title: Work safety
sections.description: Hide sensitive wallpapers and clipboard entries on public networks.

entries.label: Location
entries.description: File that stores the shell settings.

entries.label: Open the file
entries.description: Open the configuration file in the default editor.

entries.label: Copy the path
entries.description: Copy the location of the configuration file.

entries.label: Race condition delay
entries.description: Wait used by a few panels before reading state that is not ready yet.

entries.label: Dead pixel workaround
entries.description: Extend the bar and screen corners one pixel past the edge to hide a gap on some screens.

entries.label: User agent
entries.description: Browser identification sent when the shell downloads images and icons.

entries.label: Show tray item ids
entries.description: Add each tray icon's id to its tooltip, useful to hide or pin it.

entries.label: Hide sensitive wallpapers
entries.description: Blur wallpapers whose file name looks sensitive while on a public network.

entries.label: Hide sensitive clipboard entries
entries.description: Hide clipboard entries with sensitive links while on a public network.

entries.label: Public network keywords
entries.description: A network whose name contains one of these words counts as public.

entries.label: Sensitive file keywords
entries.description: Wallpaper file names containing these words are hidden.

entries.label: Sensitive link keywords
entries.description: Clipboard entries with links containing these words are hidden.

entries.label: Backends and paths
entries.description: Where settings are stored and which backends can apply them right now.

entries.label: Reset every shell setting
entries.description: Back up the configuration file, then restore every shell setting shown in this app to its default.
entries.note: Hyprland, display, idle and default app settings are not changed.
